name: TrueUSD
oneLiner: TUSD is a centralized dollar stablecoin from Techteryx with a Chainlink Proof-of-Reserve feed, though current reserves sit in opaque First Digital Trust funds.
collateral: Daily Moore Hong Kong / Chainlink-attested TUSD reserves, currently modeled by Pharos as concentrated in opaque First Digital Trust fund investments with a small cash-at-depository-institutions balance.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Techteryx; minting controlled by Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed preventing supply from exceeding attested reserves

applicabilityBasis.summary: TUSD is a U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin with issuer-managed redemption and daily reserve attestations.

genius.notes: Techteryx (current TUSD issuer, BVI-incorporated) has no confirmed U.S. GENIUS approval, application, or foreign-issuer exception. Note: the SEC settled charges in September 2024 against prior TUSD operators TrueCoin LLC and TrustToken Inc. (not Techteryx) for fraudulent unregistered sales and false reserve representations through April 2023; enforcementStatus here reflects Techteryx's own posture as current issuer. Ongoing civil litigation in Hong Kong and Dubai (worldwide asset freeze of $456M tied to First Digital Trust/Aria Commodities reserve dispute) does not constitute a U.S. enforcement action against Techteryx. TUSD delisted from EEA-regulated venues by Q1 2025 (Kraken, Binance) and several Binance spot pairs delisted April 2026.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state-qualified approval, or foreign-issuer registration source was located for TUSD/Techteryx. SEC action against prior operators TrueCoin/TrustToken (settled Sep 2024) does not constitute a Techteryx enforcement action. No FinCEN or OFAC action against Techteryx found.

mintAuthority.summary: TUSD is issuer-backed; Ethereum mint control resolves through the token controller/mint-key path, with controller ownership held by a 2/3 Safe.

controls.label: TUSD token controller
controls.evidence: Ethereum source/RPC review resolved the proxy owner/token-controller path to this controller address; the implementation exposes mint limits and mintKey controls.

controls.label: TUSD controller owner Safe
controls.evidence: Safe getThreshold() returned 2 and getOwners() returned 3 owners at Ethereum block 25165911; worker Safe API review found no modules and zero guard.

review.evidence: TrueUSD is issuer-backed; Ethereum contract review resolved the token controller, mint-key path, and 2/3 Safe controller owner.
